description: This Java source file defines an abstract class for implementing device credentials authentication providers that verify credentials against an external Credentials API. It includes methods for fetching credentials, validating them, and handling tracing and error reporting within an asynchronous vert.x environment.

classes.name: CredentialsApiAuthProvider
classes.description: An abstract class that provides a framework for authenticating device credentials using an external Credentials API, including asynchronous credential retrieval, validation, and tracing support.

methods.name: getCredentialsClient
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a CredentialsClient for the specified tenant ID.

methods.name: getCredentialsForDevice
methods.description: Fetches credentials from the Credentials API for a specific device, given device credentials and OpenTracing span context.

methods.name: authenticate (overload with deviceCredentials)
methods.description: Performs authentication of device credentials, involving credential retrieval, validation, and result handling with tracing.

methods.name: validateCredentials
methods.description: Validates the provided device credentials against credentials retrieved from the Credentials API, with tracing and error handling.

methods.name: doValidateCredentials
methods.description: Abstract method that subclasses must implement to perform credential validation logic.

methods.name: authenticate (overload with JsonObject)
methods.description: Authenticates a device based on JSON credentials info, converting it into device credentials and invoking the other authenticate method.

methods.name: getCredentials
methods.description: Abstract method for extracting device credentials from a JSON object.
